note: Draft register for Spec 057 (design D-19, PR #195 packet), opened 2026-10-21 under the runnable-experiments campaign plan the owner approved as written the same date (Part 2, member 14) and the portfolio triage of the same date, which found D-19 RIPE. Conventions as in Specs 032-046: requirement claims carry no falsification test where a gate or inspection is the operative check; boundaries carry the conditions under which each claim holds; evidence items carry observed_at from this draft because the cited facts were verified first-hand at drafting. The AEE lifecycle hooks have NOT run on this register; they are the freeze gate (tasks L4), and any recovery round they force changes claim text before any freeze digest is computed. ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on: ASM-FIVE-SOURCE-SET (the five sources are exactly the canonical record plus its four recorded evidence instances), ASM-HELD-TEXT-IS-COPY (the held cleaned text is the program's working copy of the source document; the document itself, verified by its registry checksum, is the copy of last resort), ASM-HEADING-FORM (a heading is a structural object in the document, not any occurrence of its words), ASM-ACCOUNTING-IS-SUCCESS (the design's success is a complete accounting of the five, not a count of recoveries), ASM-RECOVERY-NOT-VERIFICATION (a recovered claim is created, not checked), ASM-VERBATIM (extracted text is the pinned bytes, with line-rejoining the only permitted normalisation), ASM-APPEND-ONLY (outcomes append; frozen records are never edited), ASM-LICENSE-UNCLEAR (all five registry records carry license_status 'unclear'; verbatim passage records are internal).
